namespace MvPolynomial.TaylorCRaw
theorem universal {σ R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] A) (a : R) : f (C a) = algebraMap R A a :=
  algHom_C _ _
theorem inline {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (a : R) :
    (let T : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
      aeval fun k ↦ X k + C (α k)
     T (C a)) = C a := algHom_C _ _
#print axioms universal
#print axioms inline
end MvPolynomial.TaylorCRaw

@MvPolynomial.algHom_C : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Semiring A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] A) (r : R), f (MvPolynomial.C r) = (algebraMap R A) r

theorem MvPolynomial.algHom_C.{u, u_1, u_2} : ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2}
  [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (f : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] A) (r : R),
  f (MvPolynomial.C r) = (algebraMap R A) r :=
fun {R} {σ} [CommSemiring R] {A} [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] f r ↦ AlgHom.commutes f r

theorem MvPolynomial.aeval_C.{u, v, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval f) (MvPolynomial.C r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r :=
fun {R} {S₁} {σ} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] f r ↦ MvPolynomial.eval₂_C (algebraMap R S₁) f r

@Polynomial.taylor_C : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r x : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) (Polynomial.C x) = Polynomial.C x

theorem Polynomial.taylor_C.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r x : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) (Polynomial.C x) = Polynomial.C x :=
fun {R} [Semiring R] r x ↦ Polynomial.C_comp
